acceptanceCriteria: A closed Contract with resourceContext absent or null validates and promotes without a fabricated finalization receipt.
A resource-bound closed Contract without a valid finalization chain still fails closed with structured evidence diagnostics.
WI-819 immutable bytes remain unchanged; its generated close receipt is integrated as-is and its multilingual projections become current.
Normal close, no-resource promotion, resource-bound rejection, and no-write check behavior are covered by focused regression tests.
WI-821 own multilingual pages and parity rows pass the post-close promotion check after close.
goal: Eliminate the no-resource finalization false failure without weakening resource-bound evidence, rewriting WI-819 history, or causing a repeat of the full release workflow.
intent: Make post-close documentation promotion accept valid no-resource Work Items while retaining strict provider finalization for resource-bound Work Items, and restore the generated WI-819 close record to the reviewed main lineage.
outOfScope: Resource-bound finalization validation or release and published artifacts
Unrelated documentation failures and global Agent or MCP configuration

scenarioCoverage.expected: A closed Work Item whose Contract has no resourceContext validates and promotes without a fabricated finalization receipt.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the focused documentation-promotion regression with a valid no-resource terminal fixture.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A resource-bound closed Work Item without a valid finalization chain fails closed with structured diagnostics.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the focused regression against the existing resource-bound fixture with its finalization evidence removed.

scenarioCoverage.expected: WI-819 close evidence is integrated without changing archived bytes and its three language projections become current.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run check-all after integrating the generated WI-819 close receipt and repairing its documented projections.

scenarioCoverage.expected: WI-821 has registered multilingual pages and parity rows before close and passes its own post-close promotion check.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the lifecycle promotion check after WI-821 close and verify only its deterministic terminal fields change.
